mechanical_validation.scope: isolated scratch catalogue root with only frozen en source, context and Russian target; all validator problems retained

language_choices.register: Impersonal diagnostic statements and neutral plural/polite imperatives; no padding. Sentence case and Russian guillemets.
language_choices.agreement: Team name {role} follows с именем and is quoted without inflection. Literal tier path follows в; selector follows модель without changing its opaque value. Masculine участник governs его.
language_choices.glossary: team → команда; agent → агент; model → модель; member → участник (Russian wave-2 style guide). Technical subagents.models., provider/model, model, effort and placeholders are unchanged.
language_choices.ICU_CLDR: Only simple ICU placeholders occur. No plural or select branches are present or added. Russian one/few/many/other would apply to future cardinal messages.
language_choices.bidi: Russian LTR, no manual bidi controls. Technical Latin tokens remain in logical order.
language_choices.fit: All context notes allow natural wrapping and specify no fixed cell limit; no truncation or width exception.

ambiguities.choice: model mapping → объект настроек; effort → уровень рассуждений
ambiguities.reason: Context explicitly defines mapping as a configuration object, with required model and optional effort. Russian keeps that distinction rather than implying a model alias table.

ambiguities.choice: could not be resolved → не удалось определить
ambiguities.reason: Avoids suggesting the model was launched or exposing exception details; remediation preserves checks of model identifier and provider configuration.

glossary_proposals.model mapping: объект с настройками модели / объект настроек (in the same immediate context)

limitations: Not independently audited; independent i18n-auditor still mandatory.
No rendered proof, live UI execution or full repository validator/generation claimed.
No repository, generated catalogue, ledger or audit-history writes; no build, install, server or PR.
